macro.title: Intel Foundry Renaissance
macro.subtitle: EMIB as CoWoS Alternative + Apple M7 + Tesla AI6 + SK Hynix
macro.summary: Intel is experiencing a once-in-a-generation window to rebuild its foundry business with multiple simultaneous catalysts. TSMC CoWoS is suffering acute supply shortages — big tech turning to Intel EMIB as alternative. SK Hynix conducting joint R&D with Intel on 2.5D packaging (EMIB). Tesla AI6 chip portion originally for TSMC being transferred entirely to Intel Foundry under Trump pressure. Apple and Intel signed agreement in December 2025 — M7 chip uses Intel 18A-P (production end 2027), smartphone chip uses Intel 14A (production 2028). AWS Trainium likely using both EMIB and CoWoS via MediaTek. Whether Intel can turn this window into results depends entirely on execution.
